exact_target: Infinite compact topological symbol space, continuous strictly positive s, every periodic ordered-pair legal sequence has A above the all-sequence infimum, using source N+1 costs divided by N.
source_page_visual_inspection: EMS OWR22/2023 journal p1254, PDF physical p60, complete page rendered and inspected

attacks.all_legal_paths: Graph edges plus overlap inductively force exactly F^j(x); no concatenation or branch-switch loophole.
attacks.score_periodicity: All costs are constant along each path, which does not imply tile periodicity. Tile periodicity iff F^p(x)=x.
attacks.limsup: Exactly (N+1)(1+t)/N, hence ordinary limit; no off-by-one effect at infinity.
attacks.boundaries: t=0 minimizes and irrationality excludes periodicity; t=1 is also irrational and causes no density endpoint exception. Compact positive cost, annulus homeomorphism and closed graph hold.
attacks.gap: p/q=sqrt2+t, reduced q; p²-2q²>=1, denominator <=(2sqrt2+1)Q². Only period-bounded gap, no uniform all-period gap.
attacks.eventual_periodicity: F invertible; any eventually periodic orbit is periodic, hence t=0 excluded.
